info.name: Souvera Mail
info.summary: Nextcloud-native webmail with Nextcloud as the OIDC Provider — CLI-configurable for automated deploys
info.description:
**Souvera Mail** — Nextcloud-native webmail with Nextcloud as the OIDC Provider.
Built for automated, declarative deployments (Ansible, Helm, OCI containers, Nextcloud-AIO addons). Every configuration step is reachable through `occ` — there is no browser-based setup wizard. A read-only status panel exists for diagnostics only.
### Architecture
- Nextcloud runs the [H2CK/oidc](https://github.com/H2CK/oidc) app and is itself the OIDC Provider for the whole mail stack. - Souvera Mail receives access tokens via H2CK/oidc's `TokenGenerationRequestEvent` (in-process PHP event — no browser redirect, no token caching in the NC session). - The mail server (Stalwart 0.16+ or Dovecot 2.4+ with Postfix) validates JWTs offline against `<NC>/index.php/apps/oidc/jwks` and lets the user in via OAUTHBEARER / XOAUTH2.
### Native Nextcloud Integration
- **Contacts** — read/create/edit via NC Contacts (all address books visible) - **Files** — attach from NC Files, save emails/attachments to NC Files - **Calendar** — save ICS invitations to NC Calendar (with duplicate detection) - **Dashboard** — unread mail widget with on-demand OIDC tokens - **Search** — find emails via NC Unified Search - **OIDC Provider** — H2CK/oidc is the only IdP the mail stack needs
### `occ` Commands
``` occ souvera_mail:bootstrap # one-shot install (idempotent) occ souvera_mail:setup # set IMAP/SMTP/Sieve domain profile occ souvera_mail:oidc:register-client # register Souvera Mail as OIDC client in H2CK/oidc occ souvera_mail:status # diagnostic status (text or --json) occ souvera_mail:reset # tear down all Souvera Mail state ```
All write commands accept `--json` and `--dry-run`.
### Requirements
- Nextcloud 33-35, PHP 8.3+ - [H2CK/oidc](https://github.com/H2CK/oidc) 1.17+ (Nextcloud OIDC Provider — install via `occ app:install oidc`) - Mail server with OAUTHBEARER / XOAUTH2 (Stalwart 0.16+ or Dovecot 2.4+ + Postfix 3.7+)
